dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption data from an office building waterpark and warehouse in slovenia and energy production data from a pv plan 900kw

description: Tomaz Damjan and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The deposit groups two stated components for Ljubljana, Slovenia. One contains nine months of hourly energy consumption for a waterpark, warehouse and high-rise office buildings. The other contains ten years of hourly production from a 900 kW photovoltaic plant. The unequal periods are retained, and the source does not supply the exact calendar dates in its description. These observations support building-demand and generation modelling within the stated sites and time resolution. Their joint packaging does not prove that all demand and production observations are contemporaneous or that the buildings are physically connected to the solar plant. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
